description_expanded: Overview4 KING En-suites + Media/bunk room, 4 Bikes and beach chairs, Golf Cart Option* - 3 Minute Bike Ride, Heated Community Pool - `Seaglass`The Space Blue Mountain Beach Retreat – Luxury & Privacy with State Park Views! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Spacious Open Floor Plan – Bright, airy, & perfect for gatherings 4 Master Suites – Each bedroom has private en-suite for ultimate comfort Screened-In Porch with Gas Fireplace – Cozy outdoor lounging year-round Private Backyard with State Park Views – Serene forest setting for extra privacy Fully Stocked Kitchen – Includes modern appliances, granite countertops & beverage fridge 8-Seat Dining Table – Plenty of space for family meals & entertaining 6-Seater Golf Cart Rental Option – Golf cart available to rent at a discounted price!* One-Car Garage with EV Charger – Plus parking for 4 cars Outdoor Shower Access – Rinse off after a day at the beach 4 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s scenic trails & beach towns Minutes from the Beach – Easy access to Blue Mountain Beach’s sugar-white sandsWelcome to SeaglassWelcome to your dream beach retreat in Blue Mountain Beach! This luxurious vacation rental boasts 4 spacious bedrooms, each functioning as its own master suite for the ultimate in comfort and privacy. Nestled in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, this property is the epitome of coastal elegance and relaxation.As you step into the bright and airy living space, you'll be greeted by tasteful coastal decor and an abundance of natural light. The open-concept design seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, providing a perfect setting for gatherings with family and friends.The fully equipped kitchen is a chef's delight, featuring modern appliances, granite countertops, and ample space for culinary creations. Enjoy your meals at the dining table, or opt for a casual bite at the breakfast bar.Each of the four bedrooms is a tranquil haven, designed with your comfort in mind. With private en-suite bathrooms, plush bedding, and thoughtfully curated decor, every bedroom offers a serene escape. After a day of sun-soaked adventures, unwind in the spacious living area or step outside to the private patio to savor the coastal breeze.The property's outdoor space is a true oasis, featuring a large screened in patio. Whether you're enjoying a book or simply soaking up the Florida sunshine, this area is perfect for creating lasting memories with loved ones.Located just moments away from the pristine beaches of Blue Mountain, you'll have easy access to the sugary sands and crystal-clear waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Explore the charming community, indulge in local cuisine, and experience the laid-back lifestyle that makes Blue Mountain Beach a beloved destination.Your dream vacation awaits at this 4-bedroom, all-master-suites retreat in Blue Mountain Beach. Book your stay now and make memories that will last a lifetime!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12):First Floor Master - King sized bed, private en suite bathroomSecond Floor Master - King sized bed, private en suite bathroomSecond Floor Master - King sized bed, private en suite bathroomSecond Floor Master - King sized bed, private en suite bathroomBunk Space - Twin over Full bunk space off of living room, pull out sleeper sofaAREA ATTRACTIONS:Lakeside is a residential neighborhood at Blue Mountain Beach. A short walk/bike ride away is the community pool and multiple Blue Mountain Beach access points. Blue Mountain Beach is the perfect area for enjoying breathtaking Gulf views, exploring scenic biking trails, and discovering the unique coastal dune lakes. Nature lovers can venture to Grayton Beach State Park for hiking, paddleboarding, and a visit to the one-of-a-kind Underwater Museum of Art. The areas’ vibrant dining scene features Cowgirl Kitchen and Red Fish Taco, as well as homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery. For shopping and essentials, For the Health of It offers organic groceries and wellness products making this charming stretch of 30A a well-rounded destination.Show less
